column1: # Compound identities for Shvartsbart et al. 2022.
# Verification status is recorded per row in notes, because it differs:
#   name-verified  the published IUPAC name was parsed with OPSIN and agrees atom for atom
#   ligand-verified  agrees with the deposited chemical component in the PDB
#   core-verified  built by substitution on a core that is itself name-verified
#   source-verified  fetched from PubChem and checked against the published formula
# See ISSUES.md item 5: a formula match alone is not sufficient and was not relied on.
# The ether vector at the 6-position is labelled R1 in Tables 1 and 2 and R2 in Table 3.
# One vector, two labels in the same paper: it is keyed R1 throughout here so the R-group
# grid shows a single column, and the divergence is recorded in ISSUES.md.

The m-pyridyl amide: excellent kinase selectivity, but too polar to enter a cell. Revisited later as the starting point for the scaffold hop. The text derives it from 19 by replacing the benzamide ring, so it carries 19's (S)-tetrahydrofuran; the Table 4 drawing shows that ring without a stereo wedge. See ISSUES.md. core-verified.
Fluorine para to the amide: KIT and PDGFRB fall away. core-verified.
Methyl meta to the amide: FLT3 and TRKA fall away. core-verified.
Both trends on one ring: more than 100-fold over all four problem kinases. core-verified.
Holds both gatekeeper mutants: V555L 2.6 nM and V555M 0.9 nM. core-verified.
Best of the imidazopyridazine series on everything the campaign was optimising, then failed on CYP3A4 at 3.9 uM. name-verified against the published IUPAC name.
The scaffold hop: bridgehead nitrogen moved, cellular potency up 33-fold. core-verified; its formula is in the Supporting Information only.
Dosed in the in vivo pharmacodynamic study: pERK down, serum phosphate flat. name-verified.
The N-ethyl control: clears CYP3A4 like 29, but loses potency and selectivity. core-verified.
Lead compound. The N-CD3 amide clears CYP3A4 past 25 uM and halves clearance. Formula checked with deuterium: C23H22D3N7O3. name-verified.

The compound in the crystal structure 8E1X, and NOT the lead: its pyrazole is attached at the 3-position, its tetrahydrofuran joined through nitrogen rather than oxygen. name-verified, and its non-deuterated form matches the deposited ligand U9P atom for atom. ligand-verified.
